title: Emperors prayed here — Temple of Heaven | Beijing, Walked EP3 | China Travel Expert
description:
Ancient cypresses line every path.

Real footage from the Temple of Heaven, Beijing: cypress-lined walkways, red walls, and the queues beneath them. Emperors came here to pray for good harvests.

🧭 Expert Tip: the tree-lined paths are far quieter than the main halls — walk them first.
